chunks: Ibn Bukayr narrated from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A young girl—her father wants to marry her to one man, and her grandfather wants to marry her to another man. So he said: “The grandfather has more right in that, if the father has not already married her off before him.”

key_terms.أَبُوهَا: her father, one of the competing guardians in this case
key_terms.جَدُّهَا: her grandfather, who is given priority here
key_terms.مِنْ قَبْلِهِ: before him, indicating prior completion of the father's action
key_terms.يُزَوِّجَهَا: to marry her off, meaning to contract her marriage

ai.seo_question: Who has priority in marrying off a young girl if her father and grandfather disagree?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning guardianship in the marriage of a young girl when her father and grandfather differ. It states that the grandfather has priority in arranging the marriage, provided that the father has not already concluded it first.
